title: Atlas local runtime qualified evidence registration and regional update workflow
uncertainty: Can retained qualified regional evidence be admitted and revised through runtime library/CLI interfaces without bootstrapping from a research-created publication store, while preserving source accountability, scoped dependencies and historical publication?
importance: Read/query and deterministic processing now run through reusable runtime interfaces. Initial native registration still depends on a pre-existing seven-component research publication and fixed source/preparation adapters. This concrete onboarding gap limits broader retained-world use.
prerequisites: accepted local architecture, runtime read slice and this lifecycle integration
unchanged retained Tryfan reference and prepared Riffelhorn manifests
accepted native qualifications, dependencies, temporal and publication semantics
scope: one bounded explicit-root registration adapter for existing prepared Riffelhorn evidence plus the unchanged Tryfan reference
runtime creation of a canonical qualified regional registration from retained source/preparation manifests
one labelled administrative regional metadata revision
full validated publication, scoped dependent handling and pinned historical queries
backward-compatible reading of accepted publications; no accepted store mutation
no new datasets, scientific methods, generic ingestion platform, production application or service
deliverable: A documented library/CLI registration/update vertical slice with source-identity, qualification, interruption, lifecycle and historical-oracle tests.
acceptance: retained native evidence registers without invoking research harnesses or copying a research world store
invalid or incomplete registrations remain unpublished
a relevant revision updates exactly its dependent closure; unrelated branches reused
old and new pinned generations replay after restart
SQLite remains disposable and canonical files remain authoritative
accepted evidence/contracts/statuses/production protections and regressions pass
stop: Stop after that one registration/update workflow is measured, tested, documented and committed. Do not begin broader source acquisition, extra derivation families, cloud, production or service work.
